facts.poolSegmentation: one jackpot for each of six fixed bet-per-line values
qualifyingResultClasses: winning results in Bonus Dice as described by operator
facts.counterPersistence: remembered separately per bet-per-line setting across bet changes and leaving/returning to the game
facts.concurrentTriggerSemantics: first trigger receives current jackpot; other concurrent triggerers receive initial amount

betfair.numericObservation: The 1.40 percentage-point RTP range width numerically equals William Hill Spain's 1.40% jackpot contribution. This is an interesting cross-operator numeric alignment only; it does not prove that the lower endpoint is base RTP or that the upper endpoint is base plus jackpot for the exact same configuration.

historicalWorldPrior.label: Streak of Luck 40c Jackpot
historicalWorldPrior.trackerWarning: Casino Listings currently states that Playtech jackpot feed errors prevent accurate tracking.
historicalWorldPrior.negativeControl: Do not combine the historical '40c' label with the Spain seed formula to assert a EUR3500 seed. The tracker's recorded minimum is below that hypothetical amount and the tracker itself warns of feed errors; denomination/configuration equivalence is unproven.

stateMachine.paidDecisionStateMeaning: number of consecutive qualifying winning results currently carried for the selected bet-per-line setting
stateMachine.winTransition: n -> n+1 for n<9; state 9 plus next qualifying win triggers jackpot and counter restarts according to game rules
stateMachine.lossTransition: counter resets; streaks 4-9 may transition into Lucky Free Games benefits according to operator rules
stateMachine.complication: Bonus Dice can contribute qualifying winning results while free-spin wins do not, so the jackpot event probability per paid spin cannot be modeled as simple q^10 without a full transition model of base game + Bonus Dice + streak resets.

potentialExactEvForm.concept: For a verified fixed configuration and current streak state s, EV can be decomposed into non-jackpot game return plus state-dependent probability-weighted jackpot value and state-contingent free-game value.

advantagePlayAssessment.reason: Operator says the counter is remembered separately for each bet-per-line value, which blocks assuming that a streak built at a cheap denomination transfers to a more valuable jackpot tier.
advantagePlayAssessment.promotionSubsidizedStateCreationPotentia: RESEARCH_ONLY; a promotion/free-credit path could change economics but must be modeled separately and within operator terms.
